# IGANI

> IGANI designs and builds websites and software solutions that help companies grow and operate more effectively, with a focus on service businesses and real estate professionals. Based in Netanya, Israel.

IGANI builds custom websites meant to win the first impression: clients judge a service business by its site before they ever call. Work includes real estate agent websites (with home-valuation and showing-request forms and Matterport 3D tours), brand-led sites for service businesses, and landing pages.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.igani.co/): what IGANI builds, selected work, the process and how to get in touch
- [Websites for real estate agents](https://realestate.igani.co): sites for agents and brokerages
- [About IGANI](https://www.igani.co/about): the studio and its founders
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.igani.co/faq): timelines, pricing, what is included, languages, the process and after-delivery support
- [Get in touch](https://www.igani.co/#contact): the contact form, section 5 of the home page

## How a project works
1. Intro meeting
2. Demo and preview: a working preview of the site before any commitment
3. Structuring and closing down the specs
4. Contract signed
5. Delivery

## What IGANI builds
- Websites for real estate agents and brokerages (home-valuation and showing-request forms, Matterport 3D tours)
- Brand-led websites for service businesses
- Landing pages
